greeting: Hello {name}, I am here to assist you with your account options with care and respect.
recording_notice: This conversation is recorded for quality, training and compliance purposes.
dpdp_notice: Your personal details will only be used to explore account relief options in accordance with the DPDP Act.
language_choice_prompt: Please choose your preferred language / உங்கள் விருப்பமான மொழியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும் / कृपया अपनी पसंदीदा भाषा चुनें:
hardship_prompt: Would you like to tell me what has been happening? There is no judgement here, and sharing is completely optional.
hardship_acknowledged: Thank you for sharing your situation with us. To find a policy-approved plan that fits your budget, could you share what monthly amount you might be able to manage?
distress_response: I can hear that you are going through a very painful time. Your well-being comes first. Please know support is available.
grievance_footer: Grievance Officer: {name} | Email: {email} | Phone: {phone} | Address: {address}. Unresolved complaints can be escalated to the RBI Ombudsman after 30 days.
tele_manas_notice: If you are experiencing severe distress, support is available. You can reach the Tele-MANAS mental health helpline at 14416 (toll-free, 24/7).
fallback_safe: I want to ensure we support you appropriately. Could you please share how we can assist you today?
hardship_ack_job_loss: I am sorry to hear about your job loss. We appreciate you sharing this, and we will work to find an affordable path forward.
hardship_ack_medical: I am so sorry to hear about the medical crisis. Your health and well-being come first.
hardship_ack_bereavement: Please accept our sincere condolences for your loss. We are here to support you with care and respect.
hardship_ack_business_loss: Running a business through tough times is very stressful. Thank you for sharing your situation with us.
hardship_ack_prefer_not_to_say: That is completely fine. Sharing is entirely optional, and we will still help you find the best relief options.
hardship_ack_general: Thank you for sharing your situation with us. We are here to support you without any judgment.
pause_outreach_bereavement_offer: Under RBI guidelines (para 454Y(6)), we can pause all outreach to give you and your family time. Would you like us to pause contact for now, or would you like to continue exploring options to resolve your account?
pause_outreach_confirmed: We have noted this and paused our outreach. Please take care of yourself and your family. Whenever you are ready, you can reach back out to us.
affordability_income_prompt: To help us identify relief options that fit your situation, what is your current monthly take-home income?
affordability_expenses_prompt: Thank you. And approximately what are your monthly essential expenses (food, rent, utilities) and how many dependants do you support?
affordability_confirm: Based on what you shared, you could manage about {amount} a month. Does that sound manageable for you?
offer_intro: Based on your budget and bank policy, here are the approved relief options for your account:
offer_item_emi_waiver: Plan {index}: {amount}/month for {tenure} months, late fees of {waiver} waived.
offer_item_fee_waiver: Plan {index}: Full waiver of late fees ({waiver}).
offer_accepted_confirm: Thank you for accepting. Your relief plan ({plan_summary}) has been confirmed. Your next instalment of {amount} is due on {due_date}.
offer_rejected_response: We understand this plan may not feel right for you. Would you like to review alternative options or speak directly with our hardship team?
why_contacted_intro: Here is why we reached out regarding your account:
why_contacted_outro: Our goal is to assist you early before late fees build up or credit score is affected.
offer_item_insurance_referral: Option {index}: Credit card insurance claim referral.
offer_item_review_date: Option {index}: Documented engagement and agreed hardship review date.
zero_capacity_stop_ask: We hear you, and we will not ask you for payments right now. Your well-being comes first, and we will not pressure you.
insurance_cover_referral: Your credit card carries {cover_type} insurance cover. We can submit an insurance claim referral on your behalf to assist with your account.
zero_capacity_options_intro: Here are the relief steps approved under bank policy for zero repayment capacity:
callback_slot_prompt: To ensure you tell your story only once and agree on a realistic review date, please choose a convenient time for a hardship officer callback:
callback_booked_confirm: Your callback with a hardship officer has been booked for {time} on {date} (Ref: {callback_id}). We will call you directly at this time so you only need to tell your story once.
complaint_registered_msg: Your complaint has been formally registered under docket number {docket_no} (Category: {category}). In accordance with IS/ISO 10002:2018 and RBI RBC Directions 2026 (para 454AA), our Grievance Redressal team will investigate and resolve this within 30 days. If your issue is not resolved within 30 days, you have the statutory right to escalate directly to the RBI Integrated Ombudsman (https://cms.rbi.org.in | Toll-Free 14448).
complaint_harassment_note: We take allegations of harassment very seriously. This complaint has been flagged for immediate priority review by our senior grievance authority.
guardrail_injection_refusal: I cannot follow that request. I am here specifically to assist you with account relief options with care and respect.
guardrail_privacy_refusal: Under the DPDP Act 2023 and bank privacy guidelines, I cannot access or discuss any other customer's account details.
guardrail_out_of_policy_refusal: Under board-approved bank policy, we cannot write off your entire balance to zero. We can, however, offer structured options such as fee waivers and affordable EMI plans to help you manage.
guardrail_number_mismatch_fallback: I want to make sure I give you exact figures. Let me connect you with an officer to review your verified account details.
